name: Myopia (North Shore hunt country, late summer)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Myopia Hunt Club, South Hamilton MA: Leeds' links-like fields at a fox-hunting club, late summer. Fairways and greens a cool New England green; the rough is tall fescue and bluestem gone tawny (F0-F2 olive-gold, the course's signature look); white-tan pit bunkers; tea-dark ponds of the Miles River marsh; grey stone walls (K3-K4). Trees in assets-src/trees_myopia.py: eastern white pine, red oak, red maple with a first touch of red, American elm. The course chat's design, 2026-11-13. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
